## AI Coding Agent Instructions for Campus Phenology

**Project Overview**
- **Site Type:** Quarto website rendered to `_site/`; do not edit `_site/` directly. Core config in [_quarto.yml](_quarto.yml).
- **Data Flow:** The [{targets}](https://docs.ropensci.org/targets/) pipeline in [_targets.R](_targets.R) pulls USA-NPN data, caches semester CSV/Parquet via GitHub Releases, and writes local Parquet to [data/processed](data/processed). Quarto pages load those targets objects at render time.
- **Generated Pages:** Semester, student, and tree QMD files under [generated/](generated/) come from templates in [template/](template/). Do not hand-edit generated files.

**Key Components**
- **Pipeline:** [_targets.R](_targets.R) and [R/targets_pipeline.R](R/targets_pipeline.R). Run it with [scripts/run_targets.R](scripts/run_targets.R). [scripts/npn_download_prep.R](scripts/npn_download_prep.R) only forwards to that script. The terminal target is `site_ready`.
- **Grades:** `cp_semester_observer_stats()` scores distinct Monday–Sunday weeks with Leaves visits over a 10-week grading period. See the grading section in [template/semester_template.qmd](template/semester_template.qmd).
- **Front-end QMDs:** [index.qmd](index.qmd) loads `trees` and `d`. [semesters.qmd](semesters.qmd) is generated by `cp_write_semesters_qmd()`.
- **Optional data task:** [R/get_modis.R](R/get_modis.R) fetches MODIS NDVI. It is not part of the site pipeline.

**Build & Run**
```bash
Rscript scripts/run_targets.R
quarto render
```
CI in [\.github/workflows/publish_github_actions.yml](.github/workflows/publish_github_actions.yml) runs `targets::tar_make()` and publishes to `gh-pages`. Dependencies are pinned in [renv.lock](renv.lock).

**Conventions**
- Semester IDs are `YYYY.1` (Spring) and `YYYY.2` (Fall).
- Estimated semester start is the first Monday on or after 23 August (fall) or the Monday of the week containing 25 January (spring).
- R code follows the [tidyverse style guide](https://style.tidyverse.org/).
- Do not edit `_site/`, [semesters.qmd](semesters.qmd), or [generated/](generated/). Change templates or the pipeline instead.
